scheme_name: National Overseas Scholarship For Scheduled Caste Etc. Candidates
description:
The National Overseas Scholarship for Scheduled Caste and Other Candidates is a significant initiative by the Government of India aimed at providing financial assistance to students from Scheduled Castes and other marginalized communities.

This scholarship scheme was launched in the year 2006.

The primary objective of this scholarship is to promote higher education among students belonging to Scheduled Castes and other backward communities.

The scheme specifically targets students who wish to pursue master's degrees and doctoral programs abroad.

The scholarship covers various fields of study including engineering, management, social sciences, and humanities.

The total number of scholarships offered annually under this scheme is 100.

The financial assistance provided under this scholarship is substantial.

For master's degree programs, the scholarship amount is up to INR 20 lakh.

For doctoral programs, the scholarship amount can go up to INR 30 lakh.

The scholarship covers tuition fees, living expenses, and travel expenses.

The eligibility criteria for this scholarship are clearly defined.

Applicants must belong to the Scheduled Caste category as per the Government of India’s classification.

The annual family income of the applicant should not exceed INR 8 lakh.

Applicants must have completed their undergraduate degree with a minimum of 55% marks.

For doctoral programs, a master's degree with at least 55% marks is required.

The age limit for applicants is set at 35 years for master's degree programs.

For doctoral programs, the age limit is 40 years.

The application process for the National Overseas Scholarship is straightforward.

Interested candidates must apply online through the official website of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

The application form must be filled out completely with accurate details.

Candidates are required to upload necessary documents including educational certificates and income proof.

A valid passport is also necessary for the application process.

The application period typically opens in the month of April each year.

The deadline for submitting applications is usually set for the end of May.

After the application submission, candidates are shortlisted based on their academic performance.

Shortlisted candidates are then called for an interview.

The final selection is made based on the interview performance and academic credentials.

The disbursement of the scholarship amount occurs in two installments.

The first installment is released after the candidate secures admission to the foreign university.

The second installment is provided after the candidate completes the first semester successfully.

The implementing authority for this scholarship scheme is the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

The Ministry has designated specific departments to oversee the application and selection process.

Candidates can contact the Ministry for any queries related to the scholarship.

The contact details for the Ministry are available on their official website.

The scholarship scheme has seen a positive impact on the educational aspirations of Scheduled Caste students.

Statistical data indicates an increase in the number of applications received each year.

In the year 2020, approximately 1500 applications were received.

Out of these, 100 candidates were awarded scholarships.

The scheme aims to enhance the representation of Scheduled Castes in higher education abroad.

It also seeks to empower these communities by providing them with global exposure.

The scholarship is part of a broader initiative to promote social justice and equality in education.

The Government of India recognizes the importance of education in breaking the cycle of poverty.

The National Overseas Scholarship is one of several schemes aimed at achieving this goal.

The scholarship has been instrumental in enabling students to pursue advanced studies in prestigious institutions worldwide.

The scheme is aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.

It particularly supports Goal 4 which aims to ensure inclusive and equitable quality education.

The scholarship has also contributed to the development of a skilled workforce in India.

Beneficiaries of the scholarship have gone on to achieve significant success in various fields.

Many alumni of this program have returned to India and contributed to their communities.

The scholarship not only provides financial support but also fosters a sense of confidence among students.

It encourages them to dream big and aspire for global opportunities.

The Government of India continues to evaluate and improve the scheme based on feedback from beneficiaries.

Regular assessments are conducted to ensure that the scholarship meets its objectives.

The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment is committed to transparency in the selection process.

The scholarship scheme is widely publicized to ensure that eligible candidates are aware of the opportunities available.

Workshops and seminars are organized to guide potential applicants through the process.

The National Overseas Scholarship for Scheduled Caste and Other Candidates is a vital step towards achieving educational equity in India.

It reflects the government's commitment to supporting marginalized communities in their pursuit of higher education.

The scheme is a testament to the belief that education is a fundamental right for all individuals, regardless of their background.
